1	# Concurrent-lane protocol (2026-07-16, from inbox I-0149's incidents — BINDING for parallel agent fleets)
2	
3	Adopted after the 2026-07-16 evening wave's four incidents (I-0149). These rules extend the
4	standing handoff protocol (07-14/14b/15) for any session running two or more lanes in this
5	workspace.
6	
7	## 1. Ledger commits: private index + compare-and-swap (the shared-index race)
8	
9	All lanes commit through one `workspace.git`; concurrent `git add`+`commit` through the
10	SHARED index can interleave and record spurious deletions of another lane's
11	freshly-committed files (happened in `6197c9676`, 862 lines vanished from HEAD, restored
12	byte-identical in `a640fef5b`). Concurrent lanes MUST commit via a private index:
13	
14	```bash
15	cd /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon
16	GD=.archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git
17	export GIT_INDEX_FILE=$(mktemp)
18	git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. read-tree HEAD
19	git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. add <ONLY your paths…>
20	TREE=$(git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. write-tree)
21	PARENT=$(git --git-dir=$GD rev-parse HEAD)
22	COMMIT=$(git --git-dir=$GD -c user.name="Archon Horizon" -c user.email="archon-horizon@local" \
23	  commit-tree $TREE -p $PARENT -m "<math-first message>
24	
25	Archon-Commit: agent
26	Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>")
27	git --git-dir=$GD update-ref refs/heads/main $COMMIT $PARENT   # CAS: fails if HEAD moved
28	unset GIT_INDEX_FILE
29	```
30	
31	If the `update-ref` CAS fails (HEAD moved), re-read HEAD and repeat — never force.
32	ALWAYS verify afterward: `git --git-dir=$GD show --stat HEAD` must touch only your paths.
33	A single-lane session may keep the plain `add`+`commit` recipe, but must still verify.
34	
35	### 1b. The CAS recipe leaves the SHARED index permanently stale — this is by design, and it is armed
36	
37	Added 2026-07-27 (run 0048 r5) after this failed a **third** time (`I-0366`: the shared index
38	was pinned to a pre-round-5 snapshot and a bare `git commit` would have deleted
39	`Picard/JacobianDataCharts.lean` and un-rooted it from `AlgebraicJacobian.lean` in one commit).
40	
41	The mechanism is not a bug in anyone's lane, it is the direct consequence of §1: a CAS commit
42	publishes a tree built in a **private** `GIT_INDEX_FILE` and moves the ref with `update-ref`.
43	The **shared** index is never touched, so the moment anybody commits, the shared index still
44	describes the previous HEAD — and `git status` then reports that difference as *staged changes*,
45	including **staged deletions** for any file the commit added. The longer a run goes, the further
46	the shared index drifts behind.
47	
48	Consequences, all three binding:
49	
50	1. **Never run a bare `git commit` (no `-a`, no pathspec) against `workspace.git`.** It publishes
51	   whatever the stale shared index holds, which is a reversion of other lanes' work.
52	2. **Before finishing, check and repair.** `git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. status --porcelain | grep '^D'`
53	   must be empty. If it is not, repair with the **narrowest** form that covers your paths:
54	   `git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. reset -q -- <your project dir>/`. Prefer this to a whole-index
55	   `read-tree HEAD` when another run is live — a full reset can discard the other run's staging.
56	3. **Verify the worktree is the good copy before repairing.** `reset` makes the index match HEAD;
57	   that is only safe once you have confirmed the on-disk file is the one you want
58	   (`diff <(git --git-dir=$GD cat-file -p HEAD:<path>) <path>`).
59	
60	Expect to repeat step 2 more than once in a long session: every CAS commit by any lane re-stales
61	the index, so a repair done early does not stay done.
62	
63	## 2. The lake mutex is a mkdir DIRECTORY lock — never flock a file there
64	
65	`/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock` is acquired by `mkdir` (atomic; a crash leaves a
66	directory that the next holder's timeout logic can reap). It is NOT a flock file: a lane
67	that runs `flock /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock …` creates a plain FILE at the
68	path, and every mkdir-acquire loop then spins forever (this deadlocked all lanes
69	15:18–19:10 on 2026-07-16 until a human deleted it). Acquire pattern:
70	
71	```bash
72	LOCK=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
73	while ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; do
74	  # (a) plain FILE at the path = a flock protocol-violation; reap immediately.
75	  if [ -f "$LOCK" ]; then echo "STALE: plain file at $LOCK (flock violation) — removing" >&2; rm -f "$LOCK"; continue; fi
76	  # (b) orphaned DIRECTORY from a crashed build (rmdir never ran). Reap on proof of death:
77	  if [ -d "$LOCK" ]; then
78	    holder=$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null)
79	    if [ -n "$holder" ] && ! kill -0 "$holder" 2>/dev/null; then
80	      echo "STALE: holder pid $holder dead — reaping" >&2; rm -rf "$LOCK"; continue
81	    fi
82	    # No pidfile (old-cohort holder): reap only if NO live lake build AND the dir is >15 min old.
83	    if [ -z "$holder" ] && ! pgrep -f 'lake build AlgebraicJacobian' >/dev/null 2>&1 \
84	       && [ $(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || date +%s) )) -gt 900 ]; then
85	      echo "STALE: no live build, lock >15min old — reaping" >&2; rm -rf "$LOCK"; continue
86	    fi
87	  fi
88	  sleep 10
89	done
90	echo $$ > "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null      # record holder so a later reaper can prove liveness via kill -0
91	# … lake build … ; rm -rf "$LOCK"      # release (rm -rf, not rmdir — the pidfile makes the dir non-empty)
92	```
93	
94	Two stale shapes, both now handled above (do NOT just `sleep` forever on either):
95	- A plain FILE at the lock path is by definition stale (mkdir makes directories) — reap immediately.
96	- An orphaned DIRECTORY from a build that crashed before `rm -rf` (the 2026-07-19 C4 incident,
97	  I-0257): the OLD acquire loop only checked for a file, so it spun forever on this. Writing
98	  `$$` into `$LOCK/pid` on acquire lets the next lane prove the holder is dead (`kill -0`) and reap
99	  safely; the no-pidfile branch (a holder from before this fix) falls back to "no live build + >15min".
100	  Never reap a directory whose pidfile names a LIVE pid — that is a real build in progress.
101	
102	## 3. /tmp quota with >3 lanes
103	
104	uid-1001 tmpfs quota exhaustion (EDQUOT) bricked every Bash call machine-wide
105	(~19:00–19:20). With more than ~3 concurrent lanes, keep scratch artifacts small, clean up
106	build temp dirs, and if Bash starts failing with quota errors, stop and report rather than
107	retry-looping.
108	
109	## 4. The root import file: commit only your own lines (I-0153)
110	
111	`AlgebraicJacobian.lean` is edited by every lane. Committing the WHOLE file via any recipe
112	sweeps siblings' uncommitted import lines into HEAD — the root then references files not yet
113	in HEAD (red for fresh checkouts), and a later sibling's whole-file commit can sweep or drop
114	YOUR line the same way. Before committing the root file: run
115	`git --git-dir=$GD --work-tree=. diff HEAD -- <project>/AlgebraicJacobian.lean` — if lines
116	other than yours differ, either (a) verify every swept import's file is already committed in
117	HEAD and say so in the commit message, or (b) construct the commit from HEAD's version plus
118	only your lines (apply a minimal patch to a temp checkout of the HEAD blob). Never commit a
119	root file that references uncommitted files without naming that in the message.
120	
121	## 5. The AJCR mutex is for AJCR lake invocations only
122	
123	No cross-workspace use (an OpenGA-Horizon agent squatted it ~25 min for its own
124	`lake cache get`, silently serializing AJCR lanes against unrelated work). Other
125	workspaces must use their own lock paths.
126

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffKit
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarFunctor
8	
9	/-!
10	# Conditional final packaging of divisor representability
11	
12	DDR-9.F7 has two logically separate parts: lifting the affine equivalences to arbitrary
13	tests, and packaging the resulting natural equivalences as a `RepresentableBy` datum.
14	This file formalizes the second part.  `DivRepGlobalData` records the general-test
15	pullback, classification map, inverse laws, and naturality.  Its `representableBy`
16	constructor is the final categorical packaging.
17	
18	The affine-to-general lift is intentionally not assumed to exist implicitly: a caller
19	must provide every field of `DivRepGlobalData`.
20	-/
21	
22	set_option autoImplicit false
23	set_option quotPrecheck false
24	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
26	
27	universe u
28	
29	open CategoryTheory
30	
31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
32	
33	open Grassmannian Scheme
34	
35	section Curve
36	
37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
38	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
39	
40	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftDivRepKit :
41	    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
42	
43	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
44	  [IsIntegral C.left]
45	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
46	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
47	  [IsDominant pi]
48	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
49	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
50	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
51	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
52	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
53	variable (g r1 r2 : ℕ)
54	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
55	  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
56	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
57	  ↥(divisorSections k
58	    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
59	
60	local notation "DivOver" =>
61	  divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
62	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
63	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)
64	
65	/-- The exact general-test data needed for the final F7 packaging.  In the intended
66	construction, `pull` is assembled from the affine forward maps and `classify` by
67	gluing the affine backward classifiers. -/
68	structure DivRepGlobalData where
69	  pull : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))},
70	    (T ⟶ DivOver) → divFamZar C pi g T
71	  classify : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))},
72	    divFamZar C pi g T → (T ⟶ DivOver)
73	  classify_pull : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver),
74	    classify (pull v) = v
75	  pull_classify : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (F : divFamZar C pi g T),
76	    pull (classify F) = F
77	  pull_comp : ∀ {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
78	    (v : T ⟶ DivOver),
79	    pull (f ≫ v) = divFamZar.map C pi g f (pull v)
80	
81	namespace DivRepGlobalData
82	
83	/-- The general-test equivalence underlying the represented functor. -/
84	noncomputable def equiv
85	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
86	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
87	    (T ⟶ DivOver) ≃ divFamZar C pi g T where
88	  toFun := D.pull
89	  invFun := D.classify
90	  left_inv := D.classify_pull
91	  right_inv := D.pull_classify
92	
93	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
94	@[simp]
95	theorem equiv_apply
96	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
97	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver) :
98	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D T v
99	      = D.pull v :=
100	  rfl
101	
102	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
103	@[simp]
104	theorem equiv_symm_apply
105	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
106	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (F : divFamZar C pi g T) :
107	    (equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D T).symm F
108	      = D.classify F :=
109	  rfl
110	
111	/-- The final F7 categorical packaging: natural general-test pullback equivalences
112	represent the locally certified divisor functor by `DivScheme`. -/
113	noncomputable def representableBy
114	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2) :
115	    (divFunctor C pi g).RepresentableBy DivOver where
116	  homEquiv {T} :=
117	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D T
118	  homEquiv_comp {T T'} f v := by
119	    change D.pull (f ≫ v) = divFamZar.map C pi g f (D.pull v)
120	    exact D.pull_comp f v
121	
122	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
123	@[simp]
124	theorem representableBy_homEquiv_apply
125	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
126	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver) :
127	    (representableBy (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1)
128	      (b2 := b2) D).homEquiv v = D.pull v :=
129	  rfl
130	
131	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
132	@[simp]
133	theorem representableBy_homEquiv_symm_apply
134	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
135	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (F : divFamZar C pi g T) :
136	    (representableBy (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1)
137	      (b2 := b2) D).homEquiv.symm F = D.classify F :=
138	  rfl
139	
140	end DivRepGlobalData
141	
142	end Curve
143	
144	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepKit
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtUnit
8	
9	/-!
10	# DDR-9.F7 — the affine-to-general lift
11	
12	`Picard/DivRepKit.lean` packages a `DivRepGlobalData` (general-test pullback,
13	classification, the two inverse laws, naturality) as the divisor representability
14	datum `(divFunctor C π g).RepresentableBy DivOver`.  It deliberately does **not**
15	construct one.  This file constructs the general-test pullback of such a datum from
16	the affine package `DivRepAffinePullback` (`Picard/DivRepAffKit.lean`) — the first
17	half of the lift.
18	
19	The mechanism is the affine-open test objects `Over.fromSpecAffine T W`
20	(`Picard/PicEtUnit.lean`): every affine open `W ⊆ T.left` presents the affine test
21	`overSpec k Γ(T.left, W)` over `T`, coherently under restriction
22	(`Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom`) and along arbitrary test morphisms
23	(`Over.fromSpecAffine_naturality`).  Since the vehicle `divFamZar C π g T` is by
24	definition the family of its values on affine opens, the affine forward maps assemble
25	with **no gluing at all**:
26	
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.pullGlobal` — the general-test pullback,
28	  with value `D.pull Γ(T.left, W) (Over.fromSpecAffine T W ≫ v)` at every affine open
29	  (`pullGlobal_val`).  Compatibility under restriction is `D.pull_naturality` plus the
30	  restriction coherence of `fromSpecAffine`.
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.pullGlobal_comp` — the `divFamZar.map`
32	  naturality of `pullGlobal` in the test object, i.e. the `pull_comp` field of
33	  `DivRepGlobalData`: the characterizing `∃!`-property `divFamZar.IsPullbackValue` of
34	  the glued restriction is verified from `D.pull_naturality` and
35	  `Over.fromSpecAffine_naturality`.
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.divFamZarAffineEquiv_pullGlobal` — affine
37	  consistency: on an affine test the general-test pullback collapses through the
38	  affine comparison to `D.pull` itself.
39	
40	The remaining half of DDR-9.F7 — the general-test classifier, obtained by gluing the
41	affine classifiers `divRepClassifyZar` over an affine open cover — is not in this
42	file; see the module docstring of `Picard/DivRepKit.lean`.
43	-/
44	
45	set_option autoImplicit false
46	set_option quotPrecheck false
47	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
48	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
49	
50	universe u
51	
52	open CategoryTheory
53	
54	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
55	
56	open Grassmannian Scheme
57	
58	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra
59	
60	section Curve
61	
62	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
63	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
64	
65	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftDivRepGlobalLift :
66	    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
67	
68	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
69	  [IsIntegral C.left]
70	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
71	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
72	  [IsDominant pi]
73	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
74	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
75	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
76	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
77	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
78	variable (g : ℕ)
79	variable (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
80	variable (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
81	variable (r1 r2 : ℕ)
82	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
83	  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
84	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
85	  ↥(divisorSections k
86	    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
87	
88	local notation "DivOver" =>
89	  divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
90	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
91	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)
92	
93	namespace DivRepAffinePullback
94	
95	/-! ## The general-test pullback -/
96	
97	/-- **The general-test pullback of the affine package**: the value at an affine open
98	`W ⊆ T.left` is the affine pullback of the restriction of `v` to the affine test
99	`overSpec k Γ(T.left, W)` presented by `W`.  Compatibility under restriction of
100	affine opens is exactly `D.pull_naturality` along `Over.resAlgHom`, transported by the
101	restriction coherence `Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom`. -/
102	noncomputable def pullGlobal
103	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
104	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver) : divFamZar C pi g T :=
105	  ⟨fun W => D.pull Γ(T.left, W.1) (Over.fromSpecAffine T W ≫ v), by
106	    intro U V h
107	    beta_reduce
108	    rw [← D.pull_naturality (Over.resAlgHom T h) (Over.fromSpecAffine T V ≫ v),
109	      ← Category.assoc, Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom h]⟩
110	
111	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
112	/-- The characterizing property of `pullGlobal`: its value at an affine open is the
113	affine pullback along the affine-open test object. -/
114	@[simp]
115	theorem pullGlobal_val
116	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
117	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver)
118	    (W : T.left.affineOpens) :
119	    (pullGlobal (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
120	      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D v).1 W
121	      = D.pull Γ(T.left, W.1) (Over.fromSpecAffine T W ≫ v) :=
122	  rfl
123	
124	/-! ## Naturality in the test object -/
125	
126	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
127	/-- **The `pull_comp` field of `DivRepGlobalData` for `pullGlobal`**: the general-test
128	pullback is natural in the test object.  The value of the glued restriction
129	`divFamZar.map` is characterized by `divFamZar.IsPullbackValue`, and that property of
130	`pullGlobal (f ≫ v)` is `D.pull_naturality` along `Over.appLEAlgHom f` combined with
131	the naturality of the affine-open test objects `Over.fromSpecAffine_naturality`. -/
132	theorem pullGlobal_comp
133	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
134	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (v : T ⟶ DivOver) :
135	    pullGlobal (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
136	        (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D (f ≫ v)
137	      = divFamZar.map C pi g f
138	          (pullGlobal (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1)
139	            (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D v) := by
140	  refine divFamZar.ext fun W => ?_
141	  rw [divFamZar.map_val]
142	  refine (divFamZar.mapVal_eq_of C pi g f _ ?_).symm
143	  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
144	  rw [pullGlobal_val, pullGlobal_val,
145	    ← D.pull_naturality (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) (Over.fromSpecAffine T' W ≫ f ≫ v),
146	    ← D.pull_naturality (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (Over.fromSpecAffine T V ≫ v),
147	    ← Category.assoc (Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀)),
148	    Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom hW₀,
149	    ← Category.assoc (Over.overSpecMap (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV)),
150	    Over.fromSpecAffine_naturality f V W₀ hV, Category.assoc]
151	
152	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
153	/-- **Affine consistency**: on an affine test the general-test pullback collapses
154	through the affine comparison `divFamZarAffineEquiv` to the affine pullback `D.pull`
155	of the package. -/
156	theorem divFamZarAffineEquiv_pullGlobal
157	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
158	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (v : overSpec k A ⟶ DivOver) :
159	    divFamZarAffineEquiv C pi g A
160	        (pullGlobal (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1)
161	          (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D v)
162	      = D.pull A v := by
163	  have h := D.pull_naturality (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom
164	    (Over.fromSpecAffine (overSpec k A) (overSpecTopAffine A) ≫ v)
165	  rw [← Category.assoc, Over.overSpecMap_ΓTop_fromSpecAffine_top A, Category.id_comp] at h
166	  rw [divFamZarAffineEquiv_apply]
167	  exact h.symm
168	
169	end DivRepAffinePullback
170	
171	end Curve
172	
173	end AlgebraicGeometry

10	/-!
11	# Conditional assembly kit for affine divisor representability
12	
13	This file isolates the formal tail between a chart-wise universal certified family and
14	the affine equivalence of DDR-9.F6.  It deliberately makes the remaining F5 hypotheses
15	explicit:
16	
17	* `divRepPullAt` pulls a supplied chart family of Zariski-local classes (`DivFamZar`, not
18	  globally certified families) along a map out of a carve-chart ring;
19	* `DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible` is the exact choice-independence statement needed to
20	  glue those local pullbacks;
21	* `DivRepAffinePullback` packages the output of that glue together with the two laws and
22	  naturality;
23	* `DivRepAffinePullback.equiv` turns those data into the affine equivalence, using the
24	  already-landed uniqueness theorem for `divRepClassifyZar` for the hom-side law.
25	
26	No universal family, compatibility, inverse law, or representability theorem is asserted
27	here.  The future F5 construction must supply the fields of these interfaces.
28	-/

59	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]

78	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
79	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j

84	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j

86	/-! ## F5: pullback from one supplied universal chart family -/
87	
88	/-- Pull a supplied Zariski-locally certified **class** on one carve chart to a test
89	algebra.  This is the choice-free per-chart operation from which F5's affine forward map
90	is glued.

93	map only ever transports a class along `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom`, so a global degree-`g`
94	certificate over the chart ring is never consumed.  A caller that does hold a
95	`CertifiedDivisorFamily G` on a chart passes `(DivFam.mk G).toZar`, so no expressive
96	power is lost, while the Zariski-local production rules (`IsLocallyCertified`) become
97	usable here. -/
98	noncomputable def divRepPullAt
99	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
100	      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
101	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]

103	    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) : DivFamZar C S pi g :=
104	  DivFamZar.mapAlgHom omega (U i j)

106	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
107	@[simp]
108	theorem divRepPullAt_id
109	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
110	      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
111	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J) :
112	    divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j (AlgHom.id k (ChartRing i j))

118	their composite.  This is the algebraic part of F5 naturality. -/
119	theorem divRepPullAt_comp
120	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
121	      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
122	    {S T : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [CommRing T] [Algebra k T]

125	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi (divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega)

127	  (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp omega phi (U i j)).symm

129	namespace DivRepChartFamily
130	
131	/-- The precise F5 overlap obligation for a supplied family of classes on every carve
132	chart: two chart points inducing the same morphism to `DivScheme` have equal pulled
133	locally certified divisor classes.  The future universal-family construction proves this
134	from its epsilon identity and the total mono theorem. -/
135	def IsCompatible
136	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
137	      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g) : Prop :=
138	  ∀ {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
139	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
140	    (i' : (glueData k g r1).J) (j' : (glueData k g r2).J)
141	    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) (omega' : ChartRing i' j' →ₐ[k] S),
142	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i j
143	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega'.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i' j' →
144	      divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega
145	        = divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i' j' omega'
146	
147	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
148	/-- Compatibility may be applied when both chart presentations are identified with a
149	common morphism.  This is the form used on overlaps of an atlas factorization. -/
150	theorem pullAt_eq_of_eq_common
151	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
152	      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
153	    (hU : IsCompatible (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U)
154	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
155	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
156	    (i' : (glueData k g r1).J) (j' : (glueData k g r2).J)
157	    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) (omega' : ChartRing i' j' →ₐ[k] S)
158	    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
159	      DivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
160	        (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
161	        (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm))
162	    (homega : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i j = q)
163	    (homega' : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega'.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i' j' = q) :
164	    divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega
165	      = divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i' j' omega' :=
166	  hU i j i' j' omega omega' (homega.trans homega'.symm)
167	
168	end DivRepChartFamily
169	
170	/-! ## F6: package a completed affine pullback as an equivalence -/
171	
172	/-- The exact output expected from F5 before the affine equivalence is packaged.
173	`isDivRepClassify_pull` is the hom-side law in the refinement-stable clause spelling;
174	classifier uniqueness turns it into the second inverse law automatically. -/
175	structure DivRepAffinePullback where
176	  pull : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S],
177	    (overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) → DivFamZar C S pi g
178	  pull_classify : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
179	    (F : DivFamZar C S pi g),
180	    pull S (divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F) = F
181	  isDivRepClassify_pull : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
182	    (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver),
183	    IsDivRepClassify hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 (pull S v) v.left
184	  pull_naturality : ∀ {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
185	    [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (phi : A →ₐ[k] B) (v : overSpec k A ⟶ DivOver),
186	    pull B (Over.overSpecMap phi ≫ v) = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi (pull A v)
187	
188	namespace DivRepAffinePullback
189	
190	/-- The affine representability equivalence assembled from an F5 pullback package.
191	The inverse is the landed backward classifier; its hom-side inverse law follows from
192	`divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify`. -/
193	noncomputable def equiv
194	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
195	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] :
196	    (overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) ≃ DivFamZar C S pi g where
197	  toFun := D.pull S
198	  invFun := divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S
199	  left_inv v :=
200	    (divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
201	      (D.pull S v) v (D.isDivRepClassify_pull S v)).symm
202	  right_inv := D.pull_classify S
203	
204	@[simp]
205	theorem equiv_apply
206	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
207	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) :
208	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
209	        (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D S v = D.pull S v :=
210	  rfl
211	
212	@[simp]
213	theorem equiv_symm_apply
214	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
215	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (F : DivFamZar C S pi g) :
216	    (equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
217	      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D S).symm F
218	      = divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F :=
219	  rfl
220	
221	/-- Naturality of the assembled affine equivalence, in the frozen DDR-9 spelling. -/
222	theorem equiv_naturality
223	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
224	    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
225	    [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
226	    (v : overSpec k A ⟶ DivOver) :
227	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
228	        (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D B (Over.overSpecMap phi ≫ v)
229	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi
230	          (equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
231	            (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D A v) :=
232	  D.pull_naturality phi v
233	
234	end DivRepAffinePullback

20	  classes along an **explicit** `k`-algebra map — `DivFamZar.mapAlg` at the induced
21	  algebra tower, with the functor laws `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id`/`DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp`

169	lemma DivFam.toZar_mapAlgHom {A A' : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing A']
170	    [Algebra k A'] (φ : A →ₐ[k] A') (F : DivFam C A π n) :

181	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6 on the Addendum-2 carrier; the `divFam` vehicle):
182	compatible families of locally certified divisor classes over the affine opens of

186	Zariski-continuous extension. -/

188	  {s : Π U : T.left.affineOpens, DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, U.1) π n //
189	    ∀ (U V : T.left.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1),

196	/-- The compatibility of a section of `divFamZar` along an inclusion of affine opens. -/
197	lemma compat (s : divFamZar C π n T) (U V : T.left.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1) :
198	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (s.1 V) = s.1 U :=
199	  s.2 U V h
200	
201	/-- Two sections of `divFamZar` agreeing at every affine open are equal. -/
202	@[ext]
203	lemma ext {s t : divFamZar C π n T} (h : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens, s.1 U = t.1 U) :
204	    s = t :=
205	  Subtype.ext (funext h)
206	
207	variable (C π n T) in
208	/-- Evaluation of a section of `divFamZar` at an affine open. -/
209	def eval (U : T.left.affineOpens) : divFamZar C π n T → DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, U.1) π n :=
210	  fun s => s.1 U
211	
212	/-- Evaluation is projection to the component at the affine open. -/
213	@[simp]
214	lemma eval_apply (U : T.left.affineOpens) (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
215	    eval C π n T U s = s.1 U :=
216	  rfl
217	
218	end divFamZar
219	
220	/-! ## The affine comparison -/
221	
222	section Affine
223	
224	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
225	
226	/-- Evaluation at the top affine open of an affine test, composed with the
227	`ΓSpecIso`-transport into the test algebra: the forward direction of the affine
228	comparison. -/
229	def divFamZarToAff : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R) → DivFamZar C R π n :=
230	  fun s => DivFamZar.congr (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R) (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R))
231	
232	/-- The section of `divFamZar` over an affine test determined by a locally certified
233	divisor class of the test algebra: restrict from the top affine open — the inverse
234	direction of the affine comparison. -/
235	def divFamZarOfAff : DivFamZar C R π n → divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R) :=
236	  fun x =>
237	    ⟨fun U => DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
238	      ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
239	        (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x,
240	      fun U V h => by rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
241	        Over.resAlgHom_comp]⟩
242	
243	/-- The value of `divFamZarOfAff` at every affine open is the restricted transported
244	class. -/
245	lemma divFamZarOfAff_val (x : DivFamZar C R π n) (U : (overSpec k R).left.affineOpens) :
246	    (divFamZarOfAff C π n R x).1 U
247	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
248	          ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
249	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x :=
250	  rfl
251	
252	/-- Round trip on the vehicle side: restricting the transported top value recovers every
253	component, by the compatibility of the section. -/
254	private lemma divFamZarOfAff_divFamZarToAff (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R)) :
255	    divFamZarOfAff C π n R (divFamZarToAff C π n R s) = s := by
256	  refine divFamZar.ext fun U => ?_
257	  calc (divFamZarOfAff C π n R (divFamZarToAff C π n R s)).1 U
258	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
259	          (((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
260	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom).comp
261	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom)
262	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) :=
263	        (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _).symm
264	    _ = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top)
265	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) := by
266	        rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc,
267	          show (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom.comp
268	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom
269	            = AlgHom.id k Γ((overSpec k R).left, ⊤) from
270	            AlgHom.ext fun a => (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm_apply_apply a,
271	          AlgHom.comp_id]
272	    _ = s.1 U := s.compat U (overSpecTopAffine R) le_top
273	
274	/-- Round trip on the algebra side: the two `ΓSpecIso` transports and the trivial
275	restriction collapse to the identity (`DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id`). -/
276	private lemma divFamZarToAff_divFamZarOfAff (x : DivFamZar C R π n) :
277	    divFamZarToAff C π n R (divFamZarOfAff C π n R x) = x := by
278	  calc divFamZarToAff C π n R (divFamZarOfAff C π n R x)
279	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
280	          ((Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom.comp
281	            ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
282	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom)) x :=
283	        (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _).symm
284	    _ = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (AlgHom.id k R) x := by
285	        rw [show Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) (le_top :
286	              (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) ≤ (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens))
287	            = AlgHom.id k Γ((overSpec k R).left, ⊤) from Over.resAlgHom_rfl _ le_top,
288	          AlgHom.id_comp,
289	          show (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom.comp
290	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom
291	            = AlgHom.id k R from
292	            AlgHom.ext fun a => (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).apply_symm_apply a]
293	    _ = x := DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id x
294	
295	/-- **The affine comparison equivalence** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6, Addendum 2): on
296	an affine test `overSpec k R`, the affine-opens limit `divFamZar` collapses by
297	evaluation at the terminal element `⊤` of the affine-opens poset to the locally
298	certified divisor-functor value `DivFamZar C R π n` of the test algebra (the
299	`divFamAffineEquiv` template). -/
300	def divFamZarAffineEquiv : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R) ≃ DivFamZar C R π n where
301	  toFun := divFamZarToAff C π n R
302	  invFun := divFamZarOfAff C π n R
303	  left_inv := divFamZarOfAff_divFamZarToAff C π n R
304	  right_inv := divFamZarToAff_divFamZarOfAff C π n R
305	
306	/-- The affine comparison evaluates at the top affine open and transports along
307	`Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv`. -/
308	@[simp]
309	lemma divFamZarAffineEquiv_apply (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R)) :
310	    divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n R s
311	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom
312	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) :=
313	  rfl
314	
315	/-- The inverse affine comparison restricts the transported class from the top affine
316	open. -/
317	@[simp]
318	lemma divFamZarAffineEquiv_symm_apply_val (x : DivFamZar C R π n)
319	    (U : (overSpec k R).left.affineOpens) :
320	    ((divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n R).symm x).1 U
321	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
322	          ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
323	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x :=
324	  rfl
325	
326	end Affine
327	
328	/-! ## The comparison from the globally certified vehicle -/
329	
330	variable {C π n} in
331	/-- **The comparison from the globally certified vehicle**: componentwise
332	`DivFam.toZar`, compatible under restriction by `DivFam.toZar_mapAlg`
333	(`DivFam.toZar_mapAlgHom` on the explicit face).  Over a field the two vehicles agree
334	componentwise; over a general test this is the sheafification-of-value comparison. -/
335	def divFam.toZarVehicle {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFam C π n T) :
336	    divFamZar C π n T :=
337	  ⟨fun U => (s.1 U).toZar,
338	    fun U V h => by
339	      beta_reduce
340	      rw [← s.compat U V h, DivFam.toZar_mapAlgHom]⟩
341	
342	/-- The value of the comparison at an affine open is the comparison of the value. -/
343	@[simp]
344	lemma divFam.toZarVehicle_val {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFam C π n T)
345	    (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
346	    (divFam.toZarVehicle s).1 U = (s.1 U).toZar :=
347	  rfl
348	
349	/-- **The comparison intertwines the affine comparisons**: on an affine test, passing
350	to the locally certified vehicle and collapsing agrees with collapsing and passing to
351	the locally certified value. -/
352	lemma divFamZarAffineEquiv_toZarVehicle (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
353	    (s : divFam C π n (overSpec k R)) :
354	    divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n R (divFam.toZarVehicle s)
355	      = (divFamAffineEquiv C π n R s).toZar := by
356	  rw [divFamZarAffineEquiv_apply, divFamAffineEquiv_apply, divFam.toZarVehicle_val,
357	    DivFam.toZar_mapAlgHom]
358	
359	end
360	
361	end AlgebraicGeometry

8	/-!
9	# The locally certified divisor vehicle is a Zariski sheaf on the slice (DD-2 S6a)
10	
11	The sheaf condition of the locally certified vehicle `divFamZar` for *arbitrary*
12	Zariski open covers of *arbitrary* tests in `Over (Spec k)` — the separation and
13	gluing halves, lifted from the affine basic-open S5b keystones
14	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg` / `…ZarGlue`) through the
15	affine-opens limit.  This is the `Pic0ZariskiSheaf` mirror on the Addendum-2 carrier
16	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6), in the form the DD-R lane's `divRep` restatement
17	consumes.
18	
19	## Separation
20	
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.ext_of_le_cover`: two sections of `divFamZar C π n T`
22	  agreeing on every affine open subordinate to an open cover of `T.left` agree.
23	
24	## Gluing
25	
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.LocalData`: compatible local data on an open cover —
27	  a locally certified class at every affine open subordinate to a cover member,
28	  restricting correctly within a member (`res`) and agreeing across members on shared
29	  affine opens (`glue`).
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.IsGlueValue`: the characterizing property of the value
31	  at an affine open of a section glued from compatible local data.  Values are unique
32	  (`glueValue_unique`) and exist (`exists_isGlueValue`).
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.existsUnique_glue_of_le_cover`: **the gluing half** —
34	  a family of local sections on an open cover, compatible on the affine overlaps,
35	  glues to a unique section of `divFamZar C π n T`.
36	-/
37	
38	set_option autoImplicit false
39	/- Statements mix the section rings `Γ(T.left, ·)` with the locally certified
40	divisor-functor values over them, which are stated on the product spelling
41	`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
42	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
43	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
44	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
45	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
46	
47	universe u
48	
49	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace
50	
51	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
52	
53	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
54	
55	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
56	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
57	
58	namespace divFamZar
59	
60	/-! ## Separation -/
61	
62	/-- **Separation of the locally certified vehicle** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6,
63	Addendum 2 — the `picEt.ext_of_le_cover` mirror): two sections of `divFamZar C π n T`
64	agreeing on every affine open subordinate to an open cover of `T.left` are equal — the
65	separation half of the Zariski sheaf property at an arbitrary test. -/
66	theorem ext_of_le_cover {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {ι' : Type*}
67	    (O : ι' → T.left.Opens) (hcov : ∀ p : T.left, ∃ i, p ∈ O i)
68	    {s t : divFamZar C π n T}
69	    (h : ∀ (U : T.left.affineOpens) (i : ι'), U.1 ≤ O i → s.1 U = t.1 U) : s = t := by
70	  classical
71	  refine ext fun U => ?_
72	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover U.2
73	    (fun U₀ => ∃ i, U₀ ≤ O i)
74	    (fun w _ => by
75	      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov w
76	      exact ⟨O i, hi, ⟨i, le_rfl⟩⟩)
77	  refine eq_of_basic_eq U sub hspan (fun r hr => ?_)
78	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨i, hle⟩, hrle⟩ := hsub r hr
79	  rw [s.compat ⟨_, U.2.basicOpen r⟩ U (T.left.basicOpen_le r),
80	    t.compat ⟨_, U.2.basicOpen r⟩ U (T.left.basicOpen_le r)]
81	  exact h ⟨T.left.basicOpen r, U.2.basicOpen r⟩ i (hrle.trans hle)
82	
83	/-! ## Local data on an open cover -/
84	
85	variable {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {ι : Type u} (O : ι → T.left.Opens)
86	
87	/-- **Compatible local data** on an open cover `O` of `T.left`: a locally certified
88	class at every affine open subordinate to a cover member, restricting correctly within
89	a member (`res`) and agreeing across members on shared affine opens (`glue`).  This is
90	the input of the gluing half — the vehicle-native spelling of a compatible family of
91	local sections of `divFamZar` over the cover. -/
92	structure LocalData (v : ∀ (i : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens), W.1 ≤ O i →
93	    DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n) : Prop where
94	  res : ∀ (i : ι) (W W' : T.left.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ O i) (hW' : W'.1 ≤ O i)
95	    (h : W.1 ≤ W'.1),
96	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (v i W' hW') = v i W hW
97	  glue : ∀ (i j : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens) (hi : W.1 ≤ O i) (hj : W.1 ≤ O j),
98	      v i W hi = v j W hj
99	
100	variable (v : ∀ (i : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens), W.1 ≤ O i →
101	  DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n)
102	
103	/-- The characterizing property of the glued value at `W`: on every affine sub-open of
104	`W` contained in a cover member, it restricts to the local datum there. -/
105	def IsGlueValue (W : T.left.affineOpens) (z : DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n) : Prop :=
106	  ∀ (W₀ : T.left.affineOpens) (hW₀ : W₀.1 ≤ W.1) (i : ι) (hi : W₀.1 ≤ O i),
107	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T hW₀) z = v i W₀ hi
108	
109	variable {O v}
110	
111	/-- Glued values are unique — from the Zariski separation over a basic refinement
112	subordinate to the cover. -/
113	theorem glueValue_unique (hcov : ∀ p : T.left, ∃ i, p ∈ O i)
114	    {W : T.left.affineOpens} {z z' : DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n}
115	    (hz : IsGlueValue O v W z) (hz' : IsGlueValue O v W z') : z = z' := by
116	  classical
117	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
118	    (fun U₀ => ∃ i, U₀ ≤ O i)
119	    (fun w _ => by obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov w; exact ⟨O i, hi, ⟨i, le_rfl⟩⟩)
120	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W sub hspan (fun r hr => ?_)
121	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨i, hi⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
122	  rw [hz ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T.left.basicOpen_le r) i (hle.trans hi),
123	    hz' ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T.left.basicOpen_le r) i (hle.trans hi)]
124	
125	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
126	-- The instance towers over the section rings of the basic refinement exceed the
127	-- default elaboration budget (as in `Pic0ZariskiSheaf.exists_isGlueValue`).
128	/-- **Existence of the glued value**: compatible local data on an open cover has a
129	value at every affine open of `T.left`, glued over a finite basic-open refinement
130	subordinate to the cover — the S5b gluing keystone through
131	`divFamZar.exists_glue_of_basic_compat`. -/
132	theorem exists_isGlueValue (hcov : ∀ p : T.left, ∃ i, p ∈ O i)
133	    (hv : LocalData O v) (W : T.left.affineOpens) :
134	    ∃ z, IsGlueValue O v W z := by
135	  classical
136	  -- the basic refinement subordinate to the cover
137	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
138	    (fun U₀ => ∃ i, U₀ ≤ O i)
139	    (fun w _ => by obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov w; exact ⟨O i, hi, ⟨i, le_rfl⟩⟩)
140	  have hsub' : ∀ r ∈ sub, ∃ i, T.left.basicOpen r ≤ O i := fun r hr => by
141	    obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨i, hi⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
142	    exact ⟨i, hle.trans hi⟩
143	  choose ic hic using hsub'
144	  have hbmul : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
145	      T.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T.left, W.1)))
146	        ≤ T.left.basicOpen (r : Γ(T.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
147	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
148	    exact inf_le_left
149	  have hbmul' : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
150	      T.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T.left, W.1)))
151	        ≤ T.left.basicOpen (r' : Γ(T.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
152	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
153	    exact inf_le_right
154	  -- glue the local pieces over the basic refinement
155	  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_glue_of_basic_compat W sub hspan
156	    (fun r : ↥sub => v (ic r.1 r.2) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r.1⟩ (hic r.1 r.2))
157	    hbmul hbmul'
158	    (fun r r' => by
159	      -- the overlap compatibility, from `res` and `glue`
160	      rw [hv.res (ic r.1 r.2) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩ ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r.1⟩
161	          ((hbmul r r').trans (hic r.1 r.2)) (hic r.1 r.2) (hbmul r r'),
162	        hv.res (ic r'.1 r'.2) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩ ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r'.1⟩
163	          ((hbmul' r r').trans (hic r'.1 r'.2)) (hic r'.1 r'.2) (hbmul' r r')]
164	      exact hv.glue (ic r.1 r.2) (ic r'.1 r'.2) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩
165	        ((hbmul r r').trans (hic r.1 r.2)) ((hbmul' r r').trans (hic r'.1 r'.2)))
166	  -- the glued value has the characterizing property
167	  refine ⟨z, fun W₀ hW₀ i hi => ?_⟩
168	  obtain ⟨sub₀, hspan₀, hsub₀⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W₀.2
169	    (fun U₀ => ∃ r ∈ sub, U₀ = T.left.basicOpen r)
170	    (fun w hw => by
171	      have hwW : w ∈ (⨆ r ∈ (↑sub : Set Γ(T.left, W.1)), T.left.basicOpen r) := by
172	        rw [iSup_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top _ _ hspan]
173	        exact hW₀ hw
174	      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hwW
175	      obtain ⟨hrsub, hwr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hr
176	      exact ⟨T.left.basicOpen r, hwr, ⟨r, hrsub, rfl⟩⟩)
177	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W₀ sub₀ hspan₀ (fun q hq => ?_)
178	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, hqle⟩ := hsub₀ q hq
179	  -- the left side restricts through the glued datum
180	  have hzr : DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T (T.left.basicOpen_le r)) z
181	      = v (ic r hr) ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (hic r hr) := hz ⟨r, hr⟩
182	  have hL : DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T (T.left.basicOpen_le q))
183	      (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T hW₀) z)
184	      = v (ic r hr) ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩ (hqle.trans (hic r hr)) := by
185	    rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp,
186	      show ((T.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hW₀ : T.left.basicOpen q ≤ W.1)
187	        = (hqle.trans (T.left.basicOpen_le r)) from rfl,
188	      ← Over.resAlgHom_comp T hqle (T.left.basicOpen_le r),
189	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, hzr]
190	    exact hv.res (ic r hr) ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩ ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩
191	      (hqle.trans (hic r hr)) (hic r hr) hqle
192	  -- the right side restricts the local datum directly
193	  rw [hL, hv.res i ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩ W₀ ((T.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hi) hi
194	    (T.left.basicOpen_le q)]
195	  exact hv.glue (ic r hr) i ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩ (hqle.trans (hic r hr))
196	    ((T.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hi)
197	
198	/-! ## Assembling the glued section -/
199	
200	variable (hcov : ∀ p : T.left, ∃ i, p ∈ O i) (hv : LocalData O v)
201	
202	/-- The glued value at an affine open of `T.left`. -/
203	noncomputable def glueValue (W : T.left.affineOpens) : DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n :=
204	  (exists_isGlueValue hcov hv W).choose
205	
206	lemma glueValue_spec (W : T.left.affineOpens) :
207	    IsGlueValue O v W (glueValue hcov hv W) :=
208	  (exists_isGlueValue hcov hv W).choose_spec
209	
210	lemma glueValue_eq_of {W : T.left.affineOpens} {z : DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, W.1) π n}
211	    (hz : IsGlueValue O v W z) : glueValue hcov hv W = z :=
212	  glueValue_unique hcov (glueValue_spec hcov hv W) hz
213	
214	/-- **The glued section**: compatible local data on an open cover assembles to a
215	section of `divFamZar C π n T`. -/
216	noncomputable def glueSection : divFamZar C π n T :=
217	  ⟨fun W => glueValue hcov hv W, by
218	    intro U V h
219	    beta_reduce
220	    refine (glueValue_eq_of hcov hv ?_).symm
221	    intro W₀ hW₀ i hi
222	    rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp]
223	    exact glueValue_spec hcov hv V W₀ (hW₀.trans h) i hi⟩
224	
225	/-- The glued section restricts to the local datum on each cover member. -/
226	theorem glueSection_eq (i : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ O i) :
227	    (glueSection hcov hv).1 W = v i W hW := by
228	  have h := glueValue_spec hcov hv W W le_rfl i hW
229	  rwa [Over.resAlgHom_rfl, DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id] at h
230	
231	include hcov hv in
232	/-- **The gluing half of the Zariski sheaf property of the locally certified vehicle**
233	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6, Addendum 2 — the `picEt.existsUnique_glue_of_le_cover`
234	mirror): a family of local sections on an open cover of `T.left`, compatible on the
235	affine overlaps (`LocalData`), glues to a unique section of `divFamZar C π n T`
236	restricting to each. -/
237	theorem existsUnique_glue_of_le_cover :
238	    ∃! s : divFamZar C π n T, ∀ (i : ι) (W : T.left.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ O i),
239	      s.1 W = v i W hW := by
240	  refine ⟨glueSection hcov hv, fun i W hW => glueSection_eq hcov hv i W hW,
241	    fun s hs => ?_⟩
242	  refine ext_of_le_cover O hcov (fun U i hU => ?_)
243	  rw [hs i U hU, glueSection_eq hcov hv i U hU]
244	
245	end divFamZar

11	# F4 — the backward direction of `divRepAff` at the Zar layer
12	(`informal/w4-ddr9-worksheet.md` §2.1, steps 1, 3, 5, 6)
13	
14	A locally certified divisor class `F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g` over an affine test `S`
15	classifies to a **unique** morphism `overSpec k S ⟶ divSchemeOver g` — the content of
16	`divRepAff.symm`.  Construction: the composite certificate × frame cover of the Kit
17	(`DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover`), `divClassify` fired at each certified
18	representative with the carve discharged by DDR-9.0 (`divFamEps_carve`), the glue by
19	`Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms` with overlap agreement through the clause-transport
20	layer, and the Over packaging by `divSchemeOverHomMk` (F2).
21	
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsDivRepClassify` — **the characterizing clause** (the
23	  refinement-stable form F6 consumes): over EVERY `k`/`S`-tower test `T` carrying a
24	  certified representative `G` of the restricted class and a pair-chart framing of
25	  `ε (DivFam.mk G)`, the morphism chart-factors.  No localization hypothesis on `T`
26	  — stability under refinement of covers and change of representative is built into
27	  the quantifier.
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divClassifyZar` — **the ∃!-keystone**: `F₀` classifies to a
29	  unique clause-satisfier `Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` (overlap layer:
30	  `Picard/DivRepClassifyZarCompat.lean`).
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepClassifyZar` — **the keystone map**
32	  `DivFamZar C S π g → (overSpec k S ⟶ divSchemeOver g)`, with the characterizing
33	  lemma `divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify` and the well-definedness lemma
34	  `divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify` (any Over-hom whose scheme morphism
35	  satisfies the clause IS the classified one — Law 2's uniqueness input).
36	-/

87	morphism of the framing.  Quantifying over all tests and all representatives makes
88	the clause stable under refinement of covers and change of representative by

90	def IsDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g)
91	    (v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶

93	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁

96	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C T π g),
97	    (DivFam.mk G).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg T g F₀ →
98	    ∀ (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
99	      (w : PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j →ₐ[k] T),
100	      (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
101	          = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b₁.equivFun.toLinearMap)
102	              (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).1 →
103	      (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
104	          = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b₂.equivFun.toLinearMap)

110	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w.toRingHom) ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ i j

116	/-- **Existence half of the backward classification** (w4-ddr9 §2.1 steps 3 and 5):
117	the per-piece `divClassify` outputs over the composite certificate × frame cover —
118	with the carve discharged by DDR-9.0 (`divFamEps_carve`) — glue to a morphism
119	`Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` satisfying the characterizing clause. -/
120	theorem exists_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
121	    ∃ v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
122	        DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
123	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
124	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
125	      IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v := by
126	  classical
127	  obtain ⟨m, r, hspan, hdata⟩ :=
128	    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
129	  choose G ci cj cw hZ hcw₁ hcw₂ using hdata
130	  have hv : ∀ p : Fin m,
131	      ∃ vp : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away (r p))) ⟶

134	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),

136	    (divClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ (DivFam.mk (G p))
137	      (fun a => divFamEps_carve C π hπ g (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) a)).exists
138	  choose v hvc using hv
139	  have hglue : ∀ p q : Fin m,
140	      pullback.fst ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
141	          (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f p)
142	        ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
143	          (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f q) ≫ v p
144	      = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ v q := fun p q =>
145	    pullback_divClassifyClause_compat hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
146	      (DivFam.mk (G p)) (DivFam.mk (G q)) (hZ p) (hZ q) (hvc p) (hvc q)
147	  refine ⟨(Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
148	    (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.glueMorphisms v hglue, ?_⟩
149	  intro T _ _ _ _ GT hGT i j ω hω₁ hω₂
150	  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext
151	    ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
152	      (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.pullback₁
153	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S T))))
154	    _ _ fun p => ?_

158	  exact (pullback_chart_divClassifyClause_compat hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
159	    GT hGT ω hω₁ hω₂ (DivFam.mk (G p)) (hZ p) (hvc p)).symm

164	morphisms satisfying the characterizing clause for `F₀` agree — compare over the
165	composite certificate × frame cover (`divScheme_hom_ext` per piece,
166	`Scheme.Cover.hom_ext` globally).  In particular the classified morphism does not

168	theorem isDivRepClassify_unique (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g)
169	    {v v' : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
170	      DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
171	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
172	        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)}
173	    (hv : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v)
174	    (hv' : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v') : v = v' := by
175	  obtain ⟨m, r, hspan, hdata⟩ :=
176	    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
177	  choose G ci cj cw hZ hcw₁ hcw₂ using hdata
178	  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext
179	    (Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
180	      (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover _ _ fun p => ?_
181	  refine divScheme_hom_ext k _ _ g r₁ r₂ b₁ (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)

188	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cw p).toRingHom)
189	          ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ (ci p) (cj p) :=

193	        ≫ v' ≫ divSchemeι k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
194	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁

198	    hv' (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) (hZ p) (ci p) (cj p) (cw p) (hcw₁ p) (hcw₂ p)

203	/-- **The ∃!-keystone of the backward direction** (w4-ddr9 §2.1): a locally
204	certified divisor class over an affine test classifies to a UNIQUE morphism

206	theorem divClassifyZar (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :

234	    (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm) v r hspan
235	    (fun p => ⟨ci p, cj p, cw p,
236	      hv (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) (hZ p) (ci p) (cj p) (cw p)

240	/-- **The keystone of F4** (w4-ddr9 §2.1, `divRepAff.symm`'s content): the backward

242	morphism of `Over (Spec k)`.  Characterized by `divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify`;
243	independent of every choice by `divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify`. -/
244	noncomputable def divRepClassifyZar (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
245	    overSpec k S ⟶
246	      divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
247	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
248	        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm) :=

252	/-- **The characterizing lemma of `divRepClassifyZar`** (the F6 interface): the
253	classified morphism satisfies the clause — over every `k`/`S`-tower test with a
254	certified representative of the restricted class and a pair-chart framing of its ε
255	pair, it restricts to the chart morphism. -/
256	theorem divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
257	    IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
258	      (divRepClassifyZar hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ S F₀).left :=
259	  (exists_overHom_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀).choose_spec
260	
261	include hO hχ in
262	/-- **Well-definedness / the uniqueness interface of `divRepClassifyZar`** (Law 2's
263	input): ANY morphism of `Over (Spec k)` whose underlying scheme morphism satisfies
264	the characterizing clause for `F₀` is the classified morphism. -/
265	theorem divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g)
266	    (u : overSpec k S ⟶
267	      divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
268	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
269	        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm))
270	    (hu : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ u.left) :
271	    u = divRepClassifyZar hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ S F₀ :=
272	  Over.OverMorphism.ext (isDivRepClassify_unique hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ hu
273	    (divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀))

8	/-!
9	# The unit of the étale sheafification: `relPicFunctor ⟶ picEtFunctor`
10	
11	The Layer-2 étale Picard functor `picEt` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEt`,
12	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtMap`) receives the honest relative Picard functor
13	through a natural transformation — the **unit of the étale sheafification**
14	(gap G4 of `informal/zeta-c2-rigidification-recon.md`, shared prerequisite of the
15	global (C2) comparison and of the degree/`Pic⁰` interface):
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.fromSpecAffine T U`: the spectrum of the section ring of an
18	  affine open `U` of a test object `T`, as a test object over `T` — the bridge between
19	  the affine-opens indexing of `picEt` and the test-object indexing of `relPic`.  Its
20	  coherences: restriction (`fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom`) and naturality along an
21	  arbitrary test morphism (`fromSpecAffine_naturality`).
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicToPicEt C T`: the component at `T` — a relative Picard class
23	  restricts along `fromSpecAffine T U` to every affine open, and each restriction is
24	  sent into the plus construction by `PicEtAff.unit`; the family is compatible by
25	  `PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit` and the coherences.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt`: **affine consistency** — on an
27	  affine test the component collapses through the affine comparison
28	  (`picEtAffineEquiv`) to the unit `PicEtAff.unit` of the plus construction, so the
29	  Layer-2 unit extends the affine unit.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtUnit C : relPicFunctor C ⟶ picEtFunctor C`: the natural
31	  transformation (naturality through the `∃!`-API `picEt.IsPullbackValue` of
32	  `picEtMapVal`).
33	
34	The (C2) comparison (`PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section`, recon §1.3) will upgrade
35	the affine components to isomorphisms over section-admitting tests; injectivity of the
36	affine components is the landed (C1) `PicEtAff.unit_injective`.
37	-/
38	
39	set_option autoImplicit false

43	open CategoryTheory Opposite

46	
47	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra
48	
49	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
50	
51	noncomputable section
52	
53	/-! ## The affine-open test objects of a test object -/
54	
55	namespace Over
56	
57	/-- The spectrum of the section ring of an affine open `U ⊆ T.left`, as a test object
58	over `T`: the underlying morphism is `IsAffineOpen.fromSpec`, and it lies over `Spec k`
59	by the very definition of the section-ring algebra `Over.sectionsAlgebra`. -/
60	def fromSpecAffine (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
61	    overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1) ⟶ T :=
62	  Over.homMk U.2.fromSpec (by
63	    have h1 : Spec.map (T.hom.appLE ⊤ U.1
64	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge))
65	          ≫ (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of k))).fromSpec
66	        = U.2.fromSpec ≫ T.hom :=
67	      IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec T.hom (isAffineOpen_top _) U.2 _
68	    have h2 : (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of k))).fromSpec
69	        = Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv := by
70	      rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top, Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv]
71	    change U.2.fromSpec ≫ T.hom
72	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(T.left, U.1)))
73	    rw [Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections, Spec.map_comp, ← h2, h1])
74	
75	/-- **Naturality of `fromSpecAffine`** along an arbitrary morphism of test objects:
76	for affine opens `W ≤ f⁻¹ V`, the section-ring pullback `Over.appLEAlgHom` intertwines
77	the affine-open test objects — `IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec` in the over
78	category. -/
79	theorem fromSpecAffine_naturality {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
80	    (V : T.left.affineOpens) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) (e : W.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
81	    Over.overSpecMap (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 e) ≫ fromSpecAffine T V
82	      = fromSpecAffine T' W ≫ f := by
83	  ext : 1
84	  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 e).toRingHom)
85	      ≫ V.2.fromSpec = W.2.fromSpec ≫ f.left
86	  have h : CommRingCat.ofHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 e).toRingHom
87	      = f.left.appLE V.1 W.1 e := rfl
88	  rw [h]
89	  exact IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f.left V.2 W.2 e
90	
91	/-- **Restriction coherence of `fromSpecAffine`**: the affine-open test object of a
92	smaller affine open factors through that of a larger one, along `Spec` of the section
93	restriction. -/
94	theorem fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {U V : T.left.affineOpens}
95	    (h : U.1 ≤ V.1) :
96	    Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T h) ≫ fromSpecAffine T V = fromSpecAffine T U := by
97	  have he : U.1 ≤ (Over.Hom.left (𝟙 T)) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun x hx => by
98	    rw [Over.id_left]
99	    exact h hx
100	  rw [← Over.appLEAlgHom_id T V.1 U.1 he h, fromSpecAffine_naturality (𝟙 T) V U he,
101	    Category.comp_id]
102	
103	/-- On an affine test, the affine-open test object of the top affine open is the test
104	itself: composing with the `ΓSpecIso` identification of the section ring with the test
105	algebra gives the identity. -/
106	theorem overSpecMap_ΓTop_fromSpecAffine_top (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
107	    Over.overSpecMap (k := k) (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom
108	        ≫ fromSpecAffine (overSpec k A) (overSpecTopAffine A) = 𝟙 (overSpec k A) := by
109	  have key : Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom
110	      ≫ (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))).fromSpec
111	      = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) := by
112	    rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top, Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv, ← Spec.map_comp,
113	      Iso.inv_hom_id, Spec.map_id]
114	  ext : 1
115	  exact key
116	
117	end Over
118	
119	/-! ## The component at a test object -/
120	
121	/-- The component at a test object `T` of the unit of the étale sheafification: a
122	relative Picard class restricts along `Over.fromSpecAffine T U` to every affine open
123	`U ⊆ T.left`, and each restriction enters the plus construction through
124	`PicEtAff.unit`.  The family is compatible under restriction by naturality of the unit
125	(`PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit`) and the restriction coherence of `fromSpecAffine`. -/
126	def relPicToPicEt (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : relPic C T →* picEt C T where
127	  toFun z :=
128	    ⟨fun U => PicEtAff.unit C Γ(T.left, U.1) (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) z),
129	      fun U V h => by
130	        rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit]
131	        refine congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C Γ(T.left, U.1)) ?_
132	        calc relPicAlgMap C (Over.resAlgHom T h)
133	              (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T V) z)
134	            = relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T h)
135	                ≫ Over.fromSpecAffine T V) z :=
136	              (relPicMap_comp C (Over.fromSpecAffine T V)
137	                (Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T h)) z).symm
138	          _ = relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) z := by
139	              rw [Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom h]⟩
140	  map_one' := by
141	    refine picEt.ext fun U => ?_
142	    change PicEtAff.unit C Γ(T.left, U.1) (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) 1) = 1
143	    rw [map_one, map_one]
144	  map_mul' z w := by
145	    refine picEt.ext fun U => ?_
146	    change PicEtAff.unit C Γ(T.left, U.1) (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) (z * w))
147	      = PicEtAff.unit C Γ(T.left, U.1) (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) z)
148	        * PicEtAff.unit C Γ(T.left, U.1) (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) w)
149	    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
150	
151	@[simp]
152	lemma relPicToPicEt_val (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (z : relPic C T)
153	    (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
154	    (relPicToPicEt C T z).1 U
155	      = PicEtAff.unit C Γ(T.left, U.1) (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) z) :=
156	  rfl
157	
158	/-- **Affine consistency of the unit**: on an affine test `overSpec k A` the component
159	`relPicToPicEt` collapses, through the affine comparison `picEtAffineEquiv`, to the
160	unit `PicEtAff.unit` of the plus construction. -/
161	theorem picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
162	    (z : relPic C (overSpec k A)) :
163	    picEtAffineEquiv C A (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k A) z) = PicEtAff.unit C A z :=
164	  calc picEtAffineEquiv C A (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k A) z)
165	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom
166	          (PicEtAff.unit C Γ((overSpec k A).left, (overSpecTopAffine A).1)
167	            (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine (overSpec k A) (overSpecTopAffine A))
168	              z)) := rfl
169	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C A (relPicAlgMap C (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom
170	          (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine (overSpec k A) (overSpecTopAffine A)) z)) :=
171	        PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit C _ _
172	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C A
173	          (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap (k := k) (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom
174	            ≫ Over.fromSpecAffine (overSpec k A) (overSpecTopAffine A)) z) :=
175	        congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C A)
176	          (relPicMap_comp C (Over.fromSpecAffine (overSpec k A) (overSpecTopAffine A))
177	            (Over.overSpecMap (k := k) (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom) z).symm
178	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C A (relPicMap C (𝟙 (overSpec k A)) z) :=
179	        congrArg (fun g : overSpec k A ⟶ overSpec k A =>
180	            PicEtAff.unit C A (relPicMap C g z))
181	          (Over.overSpecMap_ΓTop_fromSpecAffine_top A)
182	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C A z := congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C A) (relPicMap_id C z)
183	
184	/-! ## The natural transformation -/
185	
186	section unit
187	
188	variable [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
189	
190	/-- Naturality of the components: restriction of the unit's image along an arbitrary
191	morphism of test objects is the unit's image of the restricted class.  Verified through
192	the `∃!`-characterization `picEt.IsPullbackValue` of the glued value of `picEtMap`,
193	using both coherences of `fromSpecAffine`. -/
194	theorem picEtMap_relPicToPicEt {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
195	    (z : relPic C T) :
196	    picEtMap C f (relPicToPicEt C T z) = relPicToPicEt C T' (relPicMap C f z) := by
197	  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
198	  rw [picEtMap_val]
199	  refine picEtMapVal_eq_of C f (relPicToPicEt C T z) ?_
200	  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
201	  rw [relPicToPicEt_val, relPicToPicEt_val, PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit, PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit]
202	  refine congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C Γ(T'.left, W₀.1)) ?_
203	  calc relPicAlgMap C (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀)
204	        (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T' W) (relPicMap C f z))
205	      = relPicAlgMap C (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀)
206	          (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T' W ≫ f) z) := by
207	        rw [relPicMap_comp C f (Over.fromSpecAffine T' W) z]
208	    _ = relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀)
209	          ≫ (Over.fromSpecAffine T' W ≫ f)) z :=
210	        (relPicMap_comp C (Over.fromSpecAffine T' W ≫ f)
211	          (Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀)) z).symm
212	    _ = relPicMap C ((Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀)
213	          ≫ Over.fromSpecAffine T' W) ≫ f) z := by
214	        rw [Category.assoc]
215	    _ = relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T' W₀ ≫ f) z := by
216	        rw [Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom hW₀]
217	    _ = relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV)
218	          ≫ Over.fromSpecAffine T V) z := by
219	        rw [Over.fromSpecAffine_naturality f V W₀ hV]
220	    _ = relPicAlgMap C (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV)
221	          (relPicMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T V) z) :=
222	        relPicMap_comp C (Over.fromSpecAffine T V)
223	          (Over.overSpecMap (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV)) z
224	
225	/-- **The unit of the étale sheafification** (gap G4 of the (C2) recon): the natural
226	transformation from the honest relative Picard functor into the étale-sheafified
227	Layer-2 functor.  On affine tests it is the unit of the plus construction
228	(`picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt`); its affine components are injective by the (C1)
229	étale separatedness (`PicEtAff.unit_injective`), and bijective over section-admitting
230	tests by the (C2) comparison. -/
231	def picEtUnit : relPicFunctor C ⟶ picEtFunctor C where
232	  app T := CommGrpCat.ofHom (relPicToPicEt C T.unop)
233	  naturality T T' g := by
234	    ext z
235	    exact (picEtMap_relPicToPicEt C g.unop z).symm
236	
237	@[simp]
238	lemma picEtUnit_app (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (z : relPic C T.unop) :
239	    (picEtUnit C).app T z = relPicToPicEt C T.unop z :=
240	  rfl
241	
242	/-- Affine consistency of the unit, natural-transformation form. -/
243	theorem picEtAffineEquiv_picEtUnit_app (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
244	    (z : relPic C (overSpec k A)) :
245	    picEtAffineEquiv C A ((picEtUnit C).app (op (overSpec k A)) z)
246	      = PicEtAff.unit C A z :=
247	  picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt C A z
248	
249	end unit
250	
251	end
252	
253	end AlgebraicGeometry

12	affine divisor package `DivRepAffinePullback` together with its naturality in the
13	test object.  This file supplies the other half — the general-test classifier — and
14	assembles the `DivRepGlobalData` of `Picard/DivRepKit.lean`, hence the divisor
15	representability of `divFunctor C π g` by `DivScheme`.
16	
17	The classifier is obtained by gluing the landed affine classifiers `divRepClassifyZar`
18	over the affine opens of the test.  Two observations make the gluing cheap:
19	
20	* The affine opens of a scheme form a **locally directed** open cover
21	  (`Scheme.directedAffineCover`), so a morphism glues from compatibility with the
22	  transition maps alone (`Scheme.OpenCover.glueMorphismsOverOfLocallyDirected`); no
23	  condition on the — in general non-affine — overlaps is needed.
24	* The required compatibility is naturality of `divRepClassifyZar` in the test algebra.
25	  That naturality is not proved from the characterizing clause: it is *forced* by the
26	  affine package, since `D.pull` is injective (`DivRepAffinePullback.equiv`) and natural
27	  (`D.pull_naturality`), so the classifier — its inverse — is natural as well.
28	
29	The results:
30	
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.classifyGlobal` — the general-test classifier,
32	  restricting at every affine open `W ⊆ T.left` to the affine classifier of the value
33	  `F.1 W` (`fromSpecAffine_classifyGlobal`).
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.toGlobalData` — the `DivRepGlobalData` of the
35	  affine package: `pullGlobal` and `classifyGlobal` are mutually inverse on every test.
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.representableBy` — **the divisor
37	  representability theorem in its conditional form**: an affine divisor package
38	  represents `divFunctor C π g` by `DivScheme`.
39	-/
